---
title: "What is the trimmed flight time of the planform optimum?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 54.4      # s the probe actually used

sink_rate, opt_plane = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane)

launch_height = 1.5
flight_time = launch_height / sink_rate
meets_target = flight_time >= 2.0
meets_target_str = "Yes" if meets_target else "No"
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{meets_target_str}, {flight_time:.2f} s"`]{.hero-value}
[trimmed flight time from 1.5 m]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The planform-optimised aircraft sinks at [`{python} f"{sink_rate:.2f}"`]{.key} m/s, yielding a flight time of [`{python} f"{flight_time:.2f}"`]{.key} seconds from a `{python} f"{launch_height:.1f}"` m standing throw. This comfortably clears the 2-second flight time target.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
footer(optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate, get_airplane)
```
